ns2:course.label: Principles of Composition
ns2:course.description: (RHET 105) Study of the methods of exposition, the problems of argument, the use of evidence, and style; practice in expository writing. This course fulfills the Campus Composition I general education requirement. Credit is not given for RHET 105 and either RHET 108 or SPCM 111 and SPCM 112.
